M-DBG-TRACK.Purpose: Observe live property changes and UI passes without depending on private engine or behavior implementations.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ProcessUI and Root.OnGUI hotkey hook, weak change timestamps and whole-engine isolation.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Property subscriptions belong to WidgetInspector; engine discovery belongs to EngineRegistry.

Requirements.REQ-001: The FlexVerse instrumentation point is the public WidgetEngine.ProcessUI method. Private reconciliation methods and behavior lifecycle setters are never patched.
Requirements.REQ-002: ChangeTracker retains weak object keys and calculates heat using the caller-supplied decay duration; nonpositive durations yield zero.
Requirements.REQ-003: The inspector context and engines rooted in FlexTools widgets are isolated as whole trees, including descendants instantiated from framework types.
Requirements.REQ-004: Root.OnGUI handles F12 before native windows can consume it, independently of engine activity; only the debugger hotkey is consumed.

Inputs.IN-001: UI pass completion and property change/update notifications.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Invokes tool observation and the inspector window toggle.
